dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - July 27, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Rangers Soar Past Mariners, Lindor Dominates Braves**

In a high-scoring affair, the Texas Rangers outlasted the Seattle Mariners 7-3, led by Joc Pederson's record-breaking night. Pederson crushed two home runs and drove in four runs, while Kumar Rocker pitched 6.2 strong innings, striking out seven and allowing just two earned runs. Francisco Lindor, meanwhile, went 3-for-5 with two home runs and six RBIs in the Mets' 14-3 thrashing of the Atlanta Braves. Lindor's performance was the highlight of a night that saw several big hits across the league.
